title: Central Compute Model Tiering & Decay Schema
description: Defines state metrics for tracking central API quality degradation, quantization drift, alignment entropy collapse, and local open-weight sovereign compute parity.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of audit evaluation.

provider_id.description: Unique identifier of the central compute vendor being evaluated.

model_endpoint.description: Target API model name or identifier string.

entropy_score.description: Calculated output token distribution entropy score.

quantization_bits_estimated.description: Estimated precision of model weight quantization (e.g. 16, 8, 4, 2).

latency_ms_per_token.description: Inference time in milliseconds per generated token.

system_prompt_overhead_tokens.description: Number of mandatory safety/guardrail system tokens injected by provider.

kolmogorov_complexity_ratio.description: Ratio of compressed context length to raw AST state size. Values < 0.20 indicate state distortion risk.

shannon_channel_capacity_bps.description: Max theoretical channel capacity bits per second over physical transport layer.

deterministic_pass.description: True if model response matches exact baseline SHA-256 seed state.

local_weights_loaded.description: Name and SHA-256 hash of locally hosted open-weight model.

local_silicon_type.description: Hardware architecture running local inference (e.g., Apple Metal, CUDA, ROCm).

local_switching_cost.description: Switching cost for open-weight local execution (must equal 0.0).
